text.pipeComps: function buildPipeComponents472(field){const arr=new Int32Array(N*N);arr.fill(-1);const comps=[],q=new Int32Array(N*N);let cid=0;for(let i=0;i<N*N;i++){const t=tiles[i];if(!field(t)||arr[i]>=0)continue;let h=0,n=0;q[n++]=i;arr[i]=cid;let wp=0,main=0;while(h<n){const j=q[h++],tt=tiles[j];if(tt.wp)wp++;if(tt.wm472||tt.sm472)main++;const x=j%N,y=(j/N)|0;for(const[dx,dy]of POW_DIR){const nx=x+dx,ny=y+dy;if(!inMap(nx,ny))continue;const z=idx(nx,ny);if(arr[z]<0&&field(tiles[z])){arr[z]=cid;q[n++]=z;}}}comps.push({id:cid,tiles:n,wp,main});cid++;}return[arr,comps];}
text.pressure: function pressureDistances472(compArr,comps,seeds,mainField){const dist=new Uint16Array(N*N);dist.fill(65535);const dq=new Int32Array(N*N*2),OFF=N*N;let head=OFF,tail=OFF;for(const i of seeds){if(i<0||i>=N*N||compArr[i]<0)continue;if(dist[i]===0)continue;dist[i]=0;dq[tail++]=i;}while(head<tail){const j=dq[head++],x=j%N,y=(j/N)|0,d=dist[j];for(const[dx,dy]of POW_DIR){const nx=x+dx,ny=y+dy;if(!inMap(nx,ny))continue;const z=idx(nx,ny);if(compArr[z]<0||compArr[z]!==compArr[j])continue;const nd=d+(mainField(tiles[z])?0:1);if(nd<dist[z]&&nd<=WATER_HOPS472+32){dist[z]=nd;if(mainField(tiles[z])&&head>0)dq[--head]=z;else dq[tail++]=z;}}}return dist;}
